semanticReview.method: Manual claim-by-claim comparison with Taiwan government formatting references

findings.supports: Taiwan government document format specifies horizontal writing from left to right and from top to bottom.
Traffic sign regulation distinguishes horizontal text from vertical text and states the respective directions.

limitations: Removed broad claims about the proportion of books, textbooks, media, or digital communication using this orientation; those claims were not supported by the sources reviewed.
